MAR.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: Budget Minister Faouzi Lekjaa said the Ministry of Economy and Finance's 2022-2026 digital transformation plan includes AI tools within the Digital Workplace DB system for creating, summarising, rephrasing and translating texts, and an eBudget chatbot.

Minister Faouzi Lekjaa said the Administration of Customs and Indirect Taxes uses data analysis and machine learning algorithms for predictive analysis in customs clearance and fraud detection, and is testing a smart system that adapts to evolving fraud patterns.
facts.system: customs predictive analysis and fraud detection

facts.fact: Minister Faouzi Lekjaa said the General Tax Directorate uses AI for user-support chatbots, to combat tax fraud and to digitise tax filing.
facts.system: General Tax Directorate AI chatbots and fraud detection

facts.fact: Minister Faouzi Lekjaa described AI in use in both customs (clearance and fraud analysis) and tax (chatbots and fraud detection).
